blurb: CorePower Yoga provides unlimited access to studio and online yoga classes through memberships and class packs. They offer special pricing for eligible groups including students, teachers, military, and seniors. They also provide Yoga Alliance-certified teacher training programs with flexible schedules and payment plans.
